% pgfplots oracle fixture (hand-written): legend entries key with per-entry
% options, transposed two-column legend, images right of the text.
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[legend entries={[red]alpha,beta,gamma,delta}, legend columns=2,
  transpose legend, legend plot pos=right, legend style={inner sep=4pt, thick}]
\addplot coordinates {(0,0) (1,1)};
\addplot coordinates {(0,1) (1,2)};
\addplot coordinates {(0,2) (1,3)};
\addplot coordinates {(0,3) (1,4)};
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
